text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What to do. Can we make it a little 
flashier?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy, Curren-chan! Lookin' mega cute today 
too☆ Sparklin' hard♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh yeaaah! I'm always keepin' it totally 
real☆ Feelin' super good～! Or whatever!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So then~ could you totally give this 
Umastagram post a super serious proofread 
for me?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Correction~? What's that, like a total 
buzzkill~☆"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The tone is a bit down right now, so 
I'd like you to rewrite it to sound more 
upbeat!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to promote the race in the 
next post, but it's a bit too plain as it 
is right now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's such a mega bummer! Gotta raise 
those vibes! K, gotcha☆ Time to hype up 
and festival hard!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪ Let's snap a photo while we're 
at it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll post this picture♪ Now, about what 
I'd like to ask of you~~――"

text_block_list.name: ＠Curren
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! [?] on weekends [?] at the 
racecourse [?][?][?][?] [?][?][?][?]”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, how is this emoji not supported? 
Wait, what's up with Curren Chan? ...Maybe 
I should go watch her race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "...Eheっ☆ I guess the promo worked, huh♪"
